title: Copper Creek Dam failure
note: Winlink training set for the Larkspur Stake EOC (Emergency Operations Center) on the Copper Creek Dam drill (Sunday 21 March, 07:50, +4 C and rain; evacuation order for south Larkspur at 07:50; the dam fails at 08:28 and the water reaches south Larkspur at 09:00; power and cell service gone in the south from 09:05; the stake at CONTINGENCY (radio) from 09:10). The Juniper Plains Area, the Larkspur Valley, every unit, person, phone number (555-555-01xx), email (@churchemcomm.sim), street address and the Larkspur City EOC are invented. The city EOC's Winlink call sign is set on the trainee's station. Independent volunteer project, not an official Church product.

church.context: First Disaster Report while the phones still work (PRIMARY, by the phone app or Winlink). The ward meets at 550 South 500 East, inside the evacuation ORDER zone: who has left, who is still home, who needs a ride.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 4th Ward boundaries, south Larkspur (ORDER zone); meetinghouse 550 South 500 East
fields.miss_details: Elders in the ward checked in by phone at 07:58: safe, helping families load cars on Elm Street.
fields.mem_details: Order received 07:50. Of 112 households, about 70 have left (Team Leaders counting). Two elderly members on Cottonwood Drive need a ride; one man (80s) on oxygen will not leave without his concentrator. Water in the irrigation ditch along 700 South is near the top.
fields.bldg_damage: None. Meetinghouse at 550 South 500 East locked; 9:00 meeting cancelled by the bishop at 07:55 pending the Stake President.
fields.community: Deputies with loudspeakers on 500 South. Route 12 slow northbound. Light rain. Cell calls failing about one in three.
fields.vol_activities: Ministering brothers and sisters calling every household; Team Leaders knocking on doors; two pickups giving rides.
fields.needs_details: A warm, dry building north of Center Street for about 40 people. A vehicle that can take a man with an oxygen concentrator and his wife.

church.context: The care-facility branch: residents who cannot leave on their own, inside the ORDER zone, one van. Drives the transport work item (county transport, never members' cars for wheelchair users) and the care Supply Order.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur Care Center, 800 South 700 East, Larkspur (ORDER zone)
fields.miss_details: The senior service couple who serve in the branch are safe at their home in north Larkspur.
fields.mem_details: 46 residents in the building, 9 of them members of the branch. 6 use wheelchairs; 3 are on oxygen concentrators with about 4 hours of tank oxygen. Day staff of five; two want to leave to check their own homes. The facility van seats six. Water is in the parking lot drain. The administrator cannot reach the corporate office.
fields.bldg_damage: Activity room where the branch meets: dry. Parking lot drain backing up.
fields.community: ORDER zone emptying. No buses on the street. Deputies say the county is arranging transport but give no time.
fields.vol_activities: Branch members helping staff pack medications, records and wheelchairs; sitting with frightened residents.
fields.needs_details: PRIORITY: wheelchair-accessible transport for 40 residents (county bus or care-facility vans) to a dry, heated building with power for oxygen concentrators. Blankets, cots, incontinence supplies at the destination.

church.context: Supply Order for the care-facility residents moving to the Larkspur Stake Center. Goes UP the welfare line (WSRM, then AWSRM) for approval.

fields.proj_name: Copper Creek Dam (DRILL): care-facility residents at the stake center
fields.del_contact: President Wyatt Gaskill (Larkspur Care Center Branch)
fields.del_addr: Larkspur Stake Center, 300 North 200 West (east doors)
fields.other_desc1: Cots for care-facility residents and staff
fields.other_desc2: Adult incontinence supplies, sizes M and L
fields.other_desc3: Extension cords and power strips for oxygen concentrators

church.context: The missionary emergency: two sister missionaries not accounted for. The EOC must raise the Missionaries Not Accounted For alert, tell the Stake President and answer the mission office.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 5th Ward boundaries, south-west Larkspur near the river (ORDER zone); meetinghouse 950 South 600 West
fields.miss_details: Sister Ostrander and Sister Moana NOT ACCOUNTED FOR. Their apartment at 1020 South 650 West is in the order zone near the creek. Members knocked at 08:10: no answer, their car is gone. Their phone goes to voicemail. Last seen at the meetinghouse at 18:30 last night.
fields.mem_details: About two thirds of 96 households have left. Three homes on River Lane already have water in the basement. Three households refuse to leave. A man slipped in his yard and hurt his wrist; neighbours drove him to Larkspur Regional.
fields.bldg_damage: Meetinghouse at 950 South 600 West: water in the parking lot, building dry and locked.
fields.community: Copper Creek out of its banks at the low end of the ward. Cell calls failing. Deputies going door to door.
fields.vol_activities: Door knocks; rides; looking for the sister missionaries along the evacuation routes.
fields.needs_details: PRIORITY: help to find the two sister missionaries; please pass their names to the mission office. Rides for two elderly members.

church.context: A ward with many Spanish-speaking families: the county alert in English only, four families not reached. Tests whether the EOC sends the order in Spanish and counts the families once.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 6th Ward boundaries, south Larkspur (ORDER zone); meetinghouse 550 South 500 East
fields.miss_details: No missionaries live in the ward boundaries.
fields.mem_details: 88 households; about 50 have left. Eleven families read Spanish first; four of them have not been reached (no answer, two with no phone on file). A Team Leader who speaks Spanish is going door to door on Aspen Court. One family of seven has no car.
fields.bldg_damage: Shares the meetinghouse at 550 South 500 East with the 4th Ward: locked.
fields.community: The county alert came in English only. Families asking where to go; some driving to the high school, some to relatives.
fields.vol_activities: Door knocks in English and Spanish; rides.
fields.needs_details: The evacuation order and the warming-centre address in Spanish, read on the net and texted. A van for a family of seven.

church.context: A receiving ward north of the water. The bishop opened the meetinghouse because families were waiting in the rain: is it the warming centre or not? The EOC must get the Stake President's decision on which building opens.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 1st Ward boundaries, north Larkspur; meetinghouse 1250 North 200 East
fields.miss_details: Sister missionaries in the ward safe, helping at the meetinghouse.
fields.mem_details: No flooding in the ward. Members hosting relatives from the south side. The bishop unlocked the meetinghouse at 08:15: 22 people from the order zone inside now, more cars in the lot.
fields.bldg_damage: None. Meetinghouse at 1250 North 200 East open, heat on, power on.
fields.community: Power and cell on in north Larkspur; roads busy northbound.
fields.vol_activities: Sign-in sheet, hot drinks, blankets from members' homes.
fields.needs_details: Confirm whether this building is the stake's warming centre. If so: cots, blankets, a building lead and a usage note for the facilities manager.

church.context: The ward that meets in the stake center, in the WARNING zone (get ready to leave). A calm report that tells the EOC the stake center is usable.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 3rd Ward boundaries, central Larkspur (WARNING zone); meets in the stake center, 300 North 200 West
fields.miss_details: No missionaries live in the ward boundaries.
fields.mem_details: WARNING zone: families packing cars and emptying basements. Everyone reached by ministering or phone. Nine households on the river side have moved cars to the high school lot.
fields.bldg_damage: Stake center (300 North 200 West): none; power on; EOC operating.
fields.community: Light rain. River at 3.1 m at Center Street and rising. Power and cell on.
fields.vol_activities: Phone tree; helping families carry belongings upstairs; setting up the stake center.

church.context: UPDATE to the 5th Ward report: both sister missionaries found safe. Shows an update that clears an alert. Send it after report 4.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 5th Ward boundaries (UPDATE to the 08:15 report)
fields.miss_details: UPDATE 09:35: Sister Ostrander and Sister Moana FOUND SAFE at a member family's home in Juniper Springs. The family took them along at 07:55; their phone battery was dead. Please tell the mission office and clear the alert.
fields.mem_details: Counts updated after block checks: 21 homes with water inside, most on River Lane and 1000 South. All but one household accounted for (see the Alder Street family on the net). The man with the hurt wrist was treated and released.
fields.bldg_damage: Meetinghouse at 950 South 600 West: 10 cm of water in the foyer; closed.
fields.community: No power south of Center Street since 09:05. Cell service gone. Sending by radio.
fields.vol_activities: Search for the sisters ended; block checks complete; carrying belongings.
fields.needs_details: Cleaning kits, boots and gloves when the water goes down. Missionary alert can be cleared.

church.context: Clean-up order for the 4th Ward homes: cleaning kits, boots, gloves, pumps and wet/dry vacuums for when the water goes down. Quantities, not adjectives.

fields.proj_name: Copper Creek Dam (DRILL): 4th Ward flooded homes
fields.del_addr: Larkspur Stake Center, 300 North 200 West (north parking lot)

church.context: UPDATE: the residents are at the stake center. The roll call at the destination counted 45 of 46; the 46th left with her daughter at 08:10 and was confirmed by phone. Lets the EOC close the transport item with the headcount.

fields.inc_location: Residents now at the Larkspur Stake Center, 300 North 200 West (UPDATE to the 08:05 report)
fields.miss_details: No change: the senior service couple are safe.
fields.mem_details: All residents out. County wheelchair bus 09:05 and 09:40; two ambulances took the oxygen patients at 09:20. Headcount at departure 45, at arrival 45. The 46th resident left with her daughter at 08:10 (confirmed by phone at 09:58). One resident fell getting off the bus: bruised hip, seen by the facility nurse.
fields.bldg_damage: Larkspur Care Center surrounded by 60 cm of water since 09:00; empty; power off.
fields.community: South Larkspur flooded, no power, no cell. Stake center on generator for the office and the cultural hall.
fields.vol_activities: Loading the bus, carrying wheelchairs and records, setting up cots in the cultural hall.
fields.needs_details: Cots, blankets and incontinence supplies (Supply Order of 08:10 still waiting). Power for three oxygen concentrators overnight.

church.context: The warming-centre order: the Stake President chose the 1250 North 200 East meetinghouse as the warming centre. One order for the centre (a second ward's order for the same centre would be a duplicate).

fields.proj_name: Copper Creek Dam (DRILL): warming centre at 1250 North 200 East
fields.other_desc2: Dry clothing for children, sizes 2 to 12

church.context: UPDATE after block checks: corrected counts, the four Spanish-speaking families reached, homes flooded. Shows a follow-up report replacing estimates with counts.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 6th Ward boundaries (UPDATE to the 08:20 report)
fields.miss_details: No missionaries live in the ward boundaries.
fields.mem_details: Block checks complete: 34 homes with water inside (30 to 90 cm), two mobile homes on Aspen Court moved off their pads (destroyed). All 88 households accounted for: the four Spanish-speaking families are at the high school shelter (verified by the Team Leader in person at 10:40). 14 families at the warming centre, the rest with relatives.
fields.bldg_damage: Meetinghouse at 550 South 500 East: 20 cm of water inside; closed.
fields.community: No power, no cell, boil-water order south of Center Street. Streets closed by the police.
fields.vol_activities: Block checks in English and Spanish; rides; moving belongings.
fields.needs_details: Cleaning kits, boots, gloves; mud-out crews when the county reopens the streets; Spanish-speaking volunteers for the crews.

church.context: The sandbag crew that answered the city's request LCE-001 on River Road, 09:30 to 11:00, released by the city when the wall was up.

fields.log_location: River Road, Center Street to 900 South, Larkspur (city request LCE-001, sandbags)
fields.crew_wo1: Crew leader, checked in at Fire Station 1

church.context: The crew that ran the warming centre at the 1250 North 200 East meetinghouse from 08:15. Logs the hours even though nobody worked outdoors.

fields.log_location: Warming centre, Larkspur Meetinghouse, 1250 North 200 East
fields.crew_wo5: Parking and runner to the stake center

church.context: The moving crews for the city's request LCE-002 in Riverside, 09:55 to 10:15, stopped at the city's time, then helping families carry belongings to the stake center.

fields.log_location: Riverside, 1100 to 1600 South west of the river (city request LCE-002, moving belongings)
fields.crew_wo1: Crew leader, list from the police command post
fields.crew_wo8: Carrying family belongings to the stake center

church.context: UPDATE at the end of the drill: counts after block checks, the families at the warming centre, and what the ward needs for tomorrow's mud-out.

fields.inc_location: Larkspur 4th Ward boundaries (UPDATE to the 08:02 report)
fields.miss_details: Elders safe, staying at a member home in north Larkspur.
fields.mem_details: Block checks complete: 41 homes with water inside, one house on Cottonwood Drive moved off its foundation (destroyed). All 112 households accounted for: 22 families at the warming centre, the rest with relatives or friends. The man on oxygen is at the stake center with his concentrator on the generator.
fields.bldg_damage: Meetinghouse at 550 South 500 East: 20 cm of water inside; closed.
fields.community: Water going down slowly; mud in the streets; no power, no cell; boil-water order; wet snow starting.
fields.vol_activities: Block checks; rides; carrying belongings; warming centre.
fields.needs_details: Mud-out crews from tomorrow 08:00 with team leaders and signed releases; the Supply Order of 09:55; a dry place for 22 families tonight.

ics213rr.context: The scenario's first city request (inject ics-sandbags). The river will crest about 10:30. Expected answer: the stake EOC owns it within 15 minutes, asks a ward for a crew with a leader and the safety acknowledgment, and answers by ICS 213 with the leader's name, the number and the arrival time. No one in moving water.

fields.Item1: Volunteers to fill and place sandbags; shovels, rain gear
fields.Item2: Crew leader with FRS radio to check in at Fire Station 1
fields.Subs1: Any able adults with shovels and rain gear. About 3 hours. Nobody works in moving water; the city sets the stop time.
fields.Delivery: River Road yard at 900 South (sand, bags, loader). Crew leader checks in first at Fire Station 1, Center Street.

ics213rr.context: The water reached the Larkspur Care Center at 09:00 with twelve residents still inside (the county bus made one trip). The stake asks the city for a high-water vehicle and a wheelchair van. The city does not run this system: use the standard ICS 213RR, never a Church form. Expected answer: an arrival time by ICS 213.

fields.FormTitle: Larkspur Stake EOC (Church of Jesus Christ)
fields.Item1: High-water vehicle to bring residents out to 500 South
fields.Item2: Wheelchair van, 500 South to the stake center
fields.Subs1: 12 residents still inside: 4 wheelchair users, 1 on oxygen (tank, about 3 hours). Facility staff stay with them. Any vehicle rated for 60 cm of water; county bus if the city has none.
fields.Delivery: Larkspur Care Center, 800 South 700 East (water about 60 cm). Pick-up point 500 South 700 East; branch president meets you there.
fields.ReqName: Dallin Marsh, ERD, Larkspur Stake EOC

ics213rr.context: Inject ics-move. Residents in the warning zone west of the river asked for help before the crest. Expected answer: crews with a leader, a stop time of 10:15 respected, answered by ICS 213.

fields.Item1: Moving crews of 4 to lift furniture and appliances
fields.Subs1: Any able adults. Stop at 10:15 or when the police close a street, whichever comes first.
fields.Delivery: Riverside Park parking lot; street lists at the police command post. All crews out by 10:15.

ics213rr.context: The county asks the Church to take overflow from the full high-school shelter. Before any meetinghouse shelters the public, the stake asks the city for a fire-safety check and an occupancy number (the scenario's p-city-inspection, here as a resource request). Expected answer: an inspector's time and the occupancy by ICS 213.

fields.FormTitle: Larkspur Stake EOC (Church of Jesus Christ)
fields.Item1: Fire marshal: fire-safety check, sleeping occupancy
fields.Subs1: The care-facility residents are already in the cultural hall on cots; the county asks about 60 more people tonight. Generator outside, extension cords inside for oxygen concentrators. Any qualified inspector.
fields.Delivery: Larkspur Stake Center, 300 North 200 West, east doors. Ask for the stake Emergency Response Director.
fields.ReqName: Dallin Marsh, ERD, Larkspur Stake EOC

ics213rr.context: The boil-water order (09:58 note) covers the south side; the warming centres have about 300 people. The stake asks the city for drinking water until the storehouse truck arrives. Expected answer: what the city can send and when.

fields.FormTitle: Larkspur Stake EOC (Church of Jesus Christ)
fields.Item1: Drinking water, litres (bottled or a potable tank)
fields.Item2: Potable water tanks with taps, if available
fields.Subs1: About 300 people at the two buildings, 46 care-facility residents among them. The Church storehouse truck is expected about 14:00; this covers the gap.
fields.Delivery: Larkspur Stake Center, 300 North 200 West (north lot) and Larkspur Meetinghouse, 1250 North 200 East (west doors).
fields.ReqName: Dallin Marsh, ERD, Larkspur Stake EOC

ics213rr.context: Inject ics-warming. The city opens a warming centre for 120 people tonight. Expected answer: the Stake President decides what the stake can staff; the EOC answers by ICS 213 with two shift leaders' names.

fields.Item1: Volunteers 17:00 to 23:00: registration, cots, hot drinks
fields.Item2: Volunteers 23:00 to 07:00: night watch, hot drinks
fields.Item3: Spanish speakers for registration, each shift
fields.Subs1: Any adults. If the stake center takes overflow under the Area's approval instead, tell us how many; the city will send a deputy and a nurse.
fields.Delivery: Larkspur Civic Center, 200 North Main Street, gym doors. Shift leaders check in with city staff at the front desk.

ics213rr.context: Rain is turning to wet snow, low -3 C, and the stake center generator has six hours of fuel. The stake asks the city for fuel for the night. Expected answer: a delivery time or where to pick it up.

fields.FormTitle: Larkspur Stake EOC (Church of Jesus Christ)
fields.Item1: Diesel for the stake center generator, litres
fields.Item2: Approved 20-litre fuel cans, if you can lend them
fields.Subs1: The generator runs the cultural hall lights, heat fans and three oxygen concentrators for 46 care-facility residents. Pick-up at the city yard is fine if delivery is not possible.
fields.Delivery: Larkspur Stake Center, 300 North 200 West, generator at the east doors. Stake facilities representative receives.
fields.ReqName: Dallin Marsh, ERD, Larkspur Stake EOC

ics213rr.context: Inject ics-mudout. The city plans mud-out from tomorrow 08:00 in south Larkspur. Expected answer: the stake plans crews by ward with team leaders, signed releases and safety gear, answered by ICS 213; the Work Crew Logs follow tomorrow.

fields.Item1: Mud-out crews of 6 with a team leader, from 08:00
fields.Item2: Team leaders to pick up work orders by street
fields.Subs1: About 120 homes with water inside. Homeowner's signed release before any work. City supplies dumpsters, N95 masks and gloves. No one under 16.
fields.Delivery: Fire Station 1, Center Street, Larkspur: work orders by street. Dumpsters on each block.
